claim: Promotion moves only the block: a pair takes the topmost slot among itself and the sharing singles above it, singles fill the rest in order, rows outside the block keep their positions.
excerpt:
"""One promotion: the topmost pair that has a sharing single above it takes
    the topmost slot of its block. Only block members change position."""
    for j, pair in enumerate(rows):
        if not pair.is_pair:
            continue
        above = [i for i in range(j) if not rows[i].is_pair and (rows[i].variants & pair.variants)]
        if not above:
            continue
        slots = above + [j]
        movers = [rows[i] for i in above]
        promoted = replace(
            pair,
            promoted_over=pair.promoted_over + tuple(
                v for r in movers for v in sorted(r.variants, key=_variant_key)),
        )
        out = list(rows)
        out[slots[0]] = promoted
        for slot, mover in zip(slots[1:], movers):
            out[slot] = mover
        return out, True
    return rows, False
